---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  # renovate: datasource=conda depName=bioconda/methylsieve
  - "bioconda::methylsieve=0.3.0"

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process METHYLSIEVE {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/b6/b6ddf32365a6fe29b43b89e0ed11ca9dda2d3f73d9a72827c9910a24ef169b2f/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/methylsieve:0.3.0--fabcb86b0e4a4051'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bam)
    tuple val(meta2), path(fasta), path(fai)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.bam"), emit: bam
    tuple val(meta), path("*.summary.tsv"), emit: summary
    tuple val(meta), path("*.mbias.tsv"), emit: mbias
    tuple val(meta), path("*.conversion-matrix.tsv"), emit: conversion_matrix, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.pdf"), emit: pdf
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('methylsieve'), eval("methylsieve --version | sed 's/^methylsieve //'"), emit: versions_methylsieve, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    if ("${bam}" == "${prefix}.bam") {
        error("Input and output names are the same, use \"task.ext.prefix\" to disambiguate!")
    }
    """
    methylsieve \\
        --reference ${fasta} \\
        --input ${bam} \\
        --output ${prefix}.bam \\
        --metrics-prefix ${prefix} \\
        ${args}
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    if ("${bam}" == "${prefix}.bam") {
        error("Input and output names are the same, use \"task.ext.prefix\" to disambiguate!")
    }
    """
    touch ${prefix}.bam
    touch ${prefix}.summary.tsv
    touch ${prefix}.mbias.tsv
    touch ${prefix}.conversion-matrix.tsv
    touch ${prefix}.mbias.pdf
    touch ${prefix}.conversion-matrix.pdf
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/methylsieve"
description: "Filter/tag unconverted reads, mask M-bias and collect conversion metrics\
  \ in methylation sequencing with methylsieve; for maximum throughput it can also\
  \ run inline in the alignment pipe (aligner | methylsieve | sort) rather than as\
  \ a standalone step"
keywords:
- "methylation"
- "bisulfite"
- "em-seq"
- "taps"
- "unconverted"
- "bam"
- "qc"
tools:
- methylsieve:
    description: "Fast, robust filtering of unconverted reads in methylation sequencing."
    homepage: "https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/methylsieve"
    documentation: "https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/methylsieve"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/methylsieve"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "Aligned SAM/BAM from a methylation aligner, in aligner (query-grouped)\
        \ order.\nMust NOT be coordinate-sorted.\n"
      pattern: "*.{bam,sam}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2573"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference genome FASTA file"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,fna}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/data_2044"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - fai:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference genome FASTA index (.fai)"
      pattern: "*.fai"
      ontologies: []
output:
  bam:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}.bam:
        type: "file"
        description: "BAM with unconverted reads tagged (or filtered) and, with `--mbias-mask`,\
          \ M-biased bases set to low quality"
        pattern: "*.bam"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  summary:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.summary.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "Conversion rates per context for the genome and each control\
          \ contig, with the applied M-bias mask lengths (TSV)"
        pattern: "*.summary.tsv"
        ontologies: []
  mbias:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.mbias.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "Methylation per read cycle (TSV)"
        pattern: "*.mbias.tsv"
        ontologies: []
  conversion_matrix:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.conversion-matrix.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "Per-template conversion histograms for the genome (EM-seq and\
          \ bisulfite) and each control contig (TSV). Not written when there is neither."
        pattern: "*.conversion-matrix.tsv"
        ontologies: []
  pdf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.pdf':
        type: "file"
        description: "M-bias and conversion matrix plots (PDF)"
        pattern: "*.pdf"
        ontologies: []
  versions_methylsieve:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - methylsieve:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - methylsieve --version | sed 's/^methylsieve //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - methylsieve:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - methylsieve --version | sed 's/^methylsieve //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@nh13"
maintainers:
- "@nh13"
